title: A Weighted Bossel-Daners Transfer Principle and a Pure-Power Robin Faber-Krahn Inequality
summary: We prove a weighted Bossel-Daners transfer principle for the first Robin eigenvalue of the $p$-Laplacian under $w=m^{1/p'}$, where $p'=p/(p-1)$. The argument combines double-density isoperimetry with spectral admissibility for singular weights and normalized-flux monotonicity. It uses an exact $BV$ zero-extension formula, an $L^{p'}(m\,dx)$ selection lemma, and a nonatomic rank map that remains well defined on positive-measure level sets.
